His 2026 whereabouts rest on inference from the 31 Dec 2024 handover to the FBI (AP via The Hill, Fortune, BBC, arise.tv) and the Dec 2025 US sentencing (CNBC, NBC), plus a passing line in an Aug 2026 Vijesti article about an unrelated Iranian hacker and a low-authority aggregator (datawallet.com).
